answer: The gate is counterparty diversity: a market on a mesa grants a seat only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties. Each deal crosses the bridge receipted, and each counterparty stakes 40 POA for it. A 200-alias ring trading only with itself counts as one, so one fake seat burns 480 POA and earns nothing without real timber to sell; the ring burns 96,000 POA for zero return. One honest trader stakes once, earns 55 POA per epoch, undiluted.
